name: ICMR Junior Research Fellowship (ICMR-JRF)
funder: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Government of India
amount: JRF/SRF stipend per current government rates + HRA + Rs 20,000/year contingency (ISTI lists old rates of Rs 25,000/28,000)
other_rules: Indian nationals with a postgraduate degree in basic science or a professional course
national entrance exam once a year
notes: About 150 fellowships (120 life sciences, 30 social sciences). Exam usually in early July; call dates not found for 2026. Stipend figures on ISTI are outdated, so confirm on the ICMR notice.
